decision.observation: High-res frame: the metal fitting on the right post's inner face resembles a bell pull-cord: a bracket on the top rail (~0.755, 0.45) with a cord running down to a curved handle end at ~(0.795, 0.68), at goose-head height. The white dome sits under the gate's lowest rail at ~(0.30, 0.69). The goose stands at ~(0.55, 0.63).
decision.hypothesis: The curved handle at the post's base is the bell-cord pull; grabbing it with the beak rings the bell and summons the groundskeeper, who takes several seconds to arrive and open the gate. Walk adjacent to the cord end first.
decision.memory: After grabbing the cord, chain waits to allow the NPC to arrive.
